residential_policy: Compulsory residential campus for all full-time undergraduate and postgraduate scholars.
room_amenities: Individual single air-cooled room for students with private balcony and natural lighting.
Furnished with bed, study table, ergonomic study chair, bookshelf, and integrated wardrobe.
High-speed Gigabit Ethernet LAN port and campus-wide Wi-Fi connectivity in every room.
24/7 power backup through central diesel generator substations.
common_facilities: Common rooms with LED televisions, table tennis, indoor board games, and daily newspapers.
Modern fully equipped gymnasium inside the residential hostel zone.
High-capacity automated commercial washing machines and laundry service points.
Reverse osmosis (RO) purified drinking water dispensers on every residential floor.
dining_and_mess: Centrally air-conditioned dining halls (New Mess & Old Mess) serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.
Four daily meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks with Tea/Coffee, and Dinner.
Student Mess Committees oversee menu planning, raw ingredient quality, and kitchen hygiene.
Night canteen facilities operating until 2:00 AM during examination periods.

wardens_and_governance.chief_warden: Office of Chief Warden, Student Welfare
wardens_and_governance.hostel_wardens: Assigned faculty wardens and resident wardens residing in faculty housing nearby.
wardens_and_governance.caretakers: 24/7 resident caretakers stationed in each hostel entrance block.
wardens_and_governance.security: Biometric entry system and round-the-clock security guards at every wing.
